title: Unfairness Despite Awareness: Group-Fair Classification with Strategic Agents
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct benchmarks related to faith or religion. Its focus is on group-fair classification in the presence of strategic agents who can manipulate their features, using demographic categories like race.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
